text:
Priya: Hey all — I'm about to open my first PR for the infra config change (small): updating the workspace layout and adding a lightweight migration. Quick q: what's the team's preferred branch name pattern and PR size target? Also my pre-commit hook is failing locally on black/ruff formatting, any tips?

Ben: welcome! branch pattern: feat/<your-username>/short-description or fix/<your-username>/... keep it under 400 lines of diff if possible. For migrations, prefer one small SQL/py migration per PR.

Priya: thanks! Example branch name: feat/priya/workspace-cleanup ?

Simon: yup that looks good. For PR size, aim for a single logical change (could be multiple commits). If it's >400 lines, split into "refactor + follow-up". Add a short checklist in the PR body.

Priya: about the pre-commit issue — running `pre-commit run --all-files` gives: 
```
black.......................................................................Failed
- hook id: black
- exit code: 1
reformatted src/inference/serve.py
1 file reformatted
```
It still blocks commit. Locally I ran `git add` after black but pre-commit still errors.

Ben: common cause: your git index changed after black reformatted files. Try `git add .` after running pre-commit, or use the auto-fix mode `pre-commit run --all-files` then `git add` then commit. If you want a one-liner: `pre-commit run --all-files && git add -A` then commit.

Priya: I tried that and still got the hook failing on ruff import-order. My pyproject.toml has: 
```
[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
select = ["E", "F", "W", "I"]
```
Should I change something?

Simon: we pin ruff config in the repo at the root; don't override unless needed. If ruff autofixes, run `ruff check --fix src/` then add. If it's import-order only, you can run `isort` or `ruff --fix`. If you're blocked, push a draft PR and tag @ben — he can help fix style quickly.

Priya: good plan. Also: who should be reviewers for infra-ish PRs? I saw CODEOWNERS but not sure who to ping.

Ben: CODEOWNERS covers most; for infra changes ping @simon for runtime infra and @olivia for repo-level (ownership). If in doubt, add the `@infra` reviewer group.

Priya: perfect. One more: PR title/commit message format? We have conventional commits or freeform?

Simon: we like short conventional-style: <scope>: <short summary> — e.g., infra: workspace layout + small migration. In PR body add a short "why" and rollout plan. Link an issue if there is one.

Priya: awesome, will do. Creating a draft PR now, tag @ben and @simon, include the checklist: 
- run pre-commit locally
- CI green
- add migration note
- smoke test steps

Ben: :thumbsup: if CI still fails on flake or lint, post the failing job log here or in the PR and we can triage quickly.

Devex Bot: Reminder: New contributor checklist template applied to PR #draft (add reviewers to trigger auto-assignment).

Priya: thanks everyone — saved me a lot of time. I'll post the PR link in a follow-up message when it's up.
